s: room (a room used for a special purpose; the term is often found in compounds with a somewhat old-fashioned character)
parlour (a room used chiefly for representation purposes; often called a gute Stube or the like)
the heated part of a traditional farmhouse (as opposed to stables, kitchen, etc.)
Stube.et: From Middle High German stube, from Old High German stuba, from Proto-West Germanic *stubu.

s: a municipality in Lower Bavaria, Germany
couch potato, homebody, stay at home (a person who prefers to remain at home, rather than participate in social events)
grounding, grounded: prohibition on leaving one's room or home, especially as a child's punishment
Leoni darf heute nicht mitspielen. Sie hat Stubenarrest.
Leoni isn't allowed to come play today. She's grounded.
Kommt man ins Land hinein, so findet man noch die Baumstümpfe, und auch bei unseren Ausgrabungen stoßen wir auf Stubben und mächtige Wurzeln.
Stubben.et: 19th century, from Low German, from Middle Low German stubbe m, from Proto-Germanic *stubbô.
